lines.text: After twenty years of building the LORD's house and his palace, Solomon rebuilt the cities Hiram had given him and settled Israelites there.
Solomon captured Hamath-zobah, built Tadmor in the wilderness, and rebuilt Upper and Lower Beth-horon as fortified cities.
Solomon made the remaining Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites forced laborers, but made his Israelites farmers and shepherds.

wrong_details.wrong: made his Israelites farmers and shepherds
wrong_details.true: the Israelites were his men of war, captains and commanders of chariots and cavalry

lines.text: Solomon moved Pharaoh's daughter out of David's house because the ark's places were holy, and he set up the priests, Levites and gatekeepers by David's ordinances.
Solomon went to Ezion-geber and Eloth, where Pharaoh sent ships and sailors, who brought 450 talents of gold from Ophir.
